name: MuseScore AppImage: patchelf baked 4K ELF segment alignment; the loader needs the host page size
component: MuseScore AppImage built with patchelf --with-page-size=4096; libsndfile.so.1 PT_LOAD segments aligned to 4096, mapped by ld.so at launch
required_postconditions: a file-backed ELF PT_LOAD segment whose (p_vaddr - p_offset) is congruent to 0 modulo 4096 can be mapped: the host page size must not exceed that congruence or ld.so refuses it with 'ELF load command address/offset not page-aligned'

failure_sink.description: MuseScore #20342: ld.so reports 'libsndfile.so.1: ELF load command address/offset not page-aligned' and the process never starts. patchelf was built --with-page-size=4096 and did not auto-detect the host page size

extraction_limitations: required_page_size at_most 4096 stands in for the glibc predicate (p_vaddr - p_offset) mod host_page == 0. The schema cannot encode a per-segment congruence, so it encodes the host page bound that the worst offending segment implies. The byte-exact per-segment check lives in tools/campaign/ldso_predicate.py, not in this contract.
the incident is HISTORICAL and FIXED; this contract exists for retro-validation and as the Class-A anchor of the two-class 16K model, not as a live upstream report.

x_campaign.quote: libsndfile.so.1: ELF load command address/offset not page-aligned
x_campaign.expected_verdict_by_host_rationale: required_page_size at_most 4096; only macos/aarch64+none (16384) exceeds it, so RS-VM-0006 fires there. The historical incident was a 16K aarch64 LINUX host (Asahi/Pi5); macos/aarch64+none is the only measured 16K profile in this tree and stands in for it.
x_campaign.real_predicate: the loader test is (p_vaddr - p_offset) mod host_page_size == 0, NOT p_align. v4.2.0-beta.2 aarch64 lib/libsndfile.so.1 PT_LOAD: p_offset=0x74000 p_vaddr=0x86000 delta=0x12000 -> delta mod 16384 = 0x2000 != 0 (rejected on 16K); delta mod 4096 = 0 (loads on 4K). 15 of 154 objects fail on 16K.
x_campaign.status: HISTORICAL, FIXED. #20342 opened 2023-12-06, closed(completed) 2023-12-07. Verified at the binary level in v4.2.0-beta.2 aarch64 (sha256 316697c5...76485). Current v4.7.4 is clean: 665 PT_LOADs, 0 rejected on 16K. NOT reportable upstream; value is retro-validation.
x_campaign.verified_by: static ELF analysis of the exact reporter asset, matching the glibc source predicate bit-for-bit; live 16K runtime confirmation not performed (needs a 16K aarch64 host)
x_campaign.correction: an earlier draft of this field wrongly said the issue was OPEN/unresolved; corrected against the GitHub API state 2026.
